result.title: Iterated Narrow Networks: Turing Completeness at Width 4 on Convex Input Spaces and the Complexity of Verification
result.comment: 41 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: We study the iterates of a fixed ReLU network $N$ of width 4, that is, the discrete-time system $x_{k+1} = N(x_k)$ on $[0,1]^4$. Equivalently, $x_k$ is the output of a weight-tied network made of $k$ copies of $N$, or of a recurrent network with no external input, started at $x_0$. We prove that every deterministic Turing machine $M$ admits such a network $N_M$. The network can be constructed in polynomial time from $M$. Each iteration has depth $\mathrm{poly}(|M|)$. The iterates of $N_M$ simulate $M$ exactly on every encoded tape. The number of iterations is proportional to the running time of $M$. Moreover, the fourth coordinate irreversibly flags every point of the convex cube $[0,1]^4$ whose simulation reads an invalid digit. This flag is the certificate that makes hardness reductions sound on convex input regions, the regime of practical verifiers. Convex regions were previously inaccessible because of a continuity obstruction inherent to ReLU networks. The correspondence has three consequences. First, reachability for iterated width-4 ReLU networks spans the full complexity hierarchy along the single axis of the time bound: it is NP-complete for a unary bound, NEXP-complete for a binary bound and RE-complete (undecidable) with no bound. Second, two extra neurons of width suffice to extend the hardness to every common smooth activation: at width 6, the robust verification problem (a promise problem with $δ/2δ$ gap) is NP-complete for $\tanh$, sigmoid, GELU, Swish, ELU, and any polynomial-time-computable continuous non-polynomial activation with a polynomial-time-computable Lipschitz constant. Third, the whole spectrum transfers to discretized Neural ODEs in dimension 5.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究宽度 4 的 ReLU 网络在凸输入域上的迭代（等价于无外部输入的权重共享循环网络），证明任一图灵机都可被这样的网络精确模拟，并据此给出可达性（NP/NEXP/RE 完全）与鲁棒验证问题的复杂度完备结论，进一步推广到 tanh、GELU 等光滑激活及 5 维离散 Neural ODE。
AI.relevance_reason: 它刻画了权重共享、循环迭代的 latent 状态更新在表达力与验证复杂度上的理论边界，可供核查 LVR 中 loop 式推理能承载多少计算、以及停止/验证判定是否本质上困难；但不涉及视觉表示或多模态证据，迁移线索需人工确认。
